a=Q.text: This sprite is to reduce lag.

QUESTION: Do you want to go to sleep? Y/N

MESSAGE: It's your bed.
I'm livestreaming right now!
To my 45 followers on ScratchingPost, I love yall.
Make sure to like and subscribe!!
Chat, you won't believe this...
This little purple midget keeps trying to talk to me!
I'll bet he's trying to ask me out on a date!
He really thinks he has a chance... with ME???
That's just plain pathetic.
I'm mean, this guy's so short... he'll legit never find any love.
Wait, what do you mean you already have a girlfriend???
How is this possible chat?? He's short.
UGH!! I wanna find love too!!! It's not fair!!!
Hey, bozo!
Didn't your mom teach you dead trees aren't safe to walk on??
Hey there!
The name's Kilo.

QUESTION: Do you need a tutorial? Y/N

MESSAGE: Um...why do you need a tutorial?
This is literally a point-and-click game.
You just press things with your mouse-
Did you even read the instructions??
Why-
How did you even get out of your house if you didn't know how to do that??
Are you telling me, you can't even think of clicking that obvious boulder over there??
So it'll roll into the gap between these islands??
Okay, so I guess you already know just to click things.
But, did you know that if you click characters multiple times, they'll have different things to say?
Trying clicking me again after I'm done talking.
There ya go!
Sometimes this'll be necessary to progress.
Or sometimes sprites will say something funny.
Anyway, see ya later!
I don't mean to be rude, but don't you have somewhere else to be?
C'mon, I have things to do too!
Don't waste your time talking to me silly, do something!!
Dude, stop interacting with me.
JK, I'm not gonna do that, I'd get in trouble.
First of all, for oofing someone, second for possession of a military grade weapon.
Don't ask where I got it.
Lol
Seriously though, GOOOOOO.
I'm just gonna ignore you now.
Fine, you actually wanna get rocket launchered?
You asked for it.
OH MY GOODNESS!
Cmon' man, it's not rocket science, it's fixing a bus engine!
Alrighty', that should keep this bus running until I can get it to a mechanic.
Remember you can hold the mouse down to scrub the leaks.
...and how do you plan to get to scratchville?
Hey there.
I'm guessing you wanna ride the bus like last time.
First, of all, it costs about 4 coins for a ticket.
Didn't bring enough money, did you?
Well, there was supposed to be a money feature in this game
Coins hidden throughout the map, that you could collect to spend for important items.
But, uh the creator had a deadline, that being his birthday.
So, yeah it wasn't fully implemented
Hence, the reason you got the shield for free.
It's not gonna be free in the full release either.
Anyway, this dialogue will get cut out. Now we're going back to the way this conversation was supposed to go.
Okay, now that I have your money, I have something else to tell you.
The bus is fueled up this time...
But the engines gone kaput.

QUESTION: I ain't waiting all day for a mechanic, think you can help me fix it? Y/N

MESSAGE: Alright, just wipe up the oil leaks, I'll take care of the rest.
Well, I can't take you anywhere then.
Let's get going, shall we?
YOU!!
IT'S YOUR FAULT I GOT SENT TO JAIL FOR TRASHING THE SUPERMARKET!!
IMMA SEND YOU HOME IN A COFFIN BOY!!!
What in Griff's name is wrong with you?
I'm literally trying to oof you...
And you just stand there with that goofy smile on your face.
Do you have no survival instinct at all???
What the hack is that thing??
If this is a prank kid, then I swear to Griff that I'll-
AAAA
I'm a sprite, Globo is my name.
I sell pomegranates.
It may be a simple way of living.
But at least I know what I'm doing with my life.
Just how many people out there can say that?
Hello, I am Gobia.
I'm selling shields, but business has really sucked lately.

QUESTION: Would you like a shield for free? Y/N

MESSAGE: Perfect, here you go.
I should have known selling these was a bad idea.
(You have a shield now)
(This is placeholder text lol, I'll probably replace this at some point -Mark)
Usually I'm scared all the time...
But now, I'm terrified.
Because that guy is something else!!
Some big guy is over at the dock next door.
Good thing this wall is here.
Because he sounds pretty mad!
Whatever you do, don't go over there.
Why must I see his face yet again!?
We found the picture in his house.
His purchase history indicates he bought it two weeks ago.
What are your orders?
Find Atto, erase his memory.
And then... track where he bought this picture from.
Yes ma'am.
So uh, am I getting paid for distracting him while you guys did your thing...
or...
This never happened.
